prerequisites: Course succeeds to compulsory courses of previous semester

learning_outcomes.text: The student will be able to understand the basic standardized nomenclatures and categories of vehicles.
The student will gain basic knowledge about the dynamics of cars.
The student will acquire a basic design overview of vehicles.
The student will be able to perform basic calculations of structural parts.
